description: Based on user interest, we have introduced new pricing packages. For developers looking to share across their organization with unlimited viewers, we recommend: Enterprise Developer Plan Enterprise Reseller Plan (a discounted option for teams with more than 5 developers) For smaller organizations or individual users who need to export reports or embed them on the web, we suggest: Developer Solo Plan Developer Reseller Plan (a discounted option for teams with more than 5 developers) 12-level Sankey Diagram in Microsoft Power BI Sankey Diagram for Power BI is a powerful visualization tool designed to provide users with an intuitive means of representing complex data flows and relationships. With VisioChart, you can create a Sankey Diagram with up to 12 levels. You have the ability to customize and set properties for all components of the Sankey diagram, including nodes, flows, statistics, text, colors, and more. Sankey Diagram Components using VisioChart Nodes refer to different stages of a flow. e.g. The various web pages on a website are depicted in a user flow diagram. Flows represent relationships between nodes. e.g. In a browser's flow chart, flows represent traffic approaching and heading website pages.
